LanguageData.Rimverse_CombatHud2: Your ship: hull {0}, shield {1} · Enemy: hull {2}, shield {3}
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterShipCombat:
A ship of {0}, the {1}, has come out of the dark on an attack course.
Use the orders on the bridge to close in, hold, flee or board. Weapons fire on their own when the enemy is in their range.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterCombatLost: Your ship's bridge was destroyed or taken. The battle is over.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterCombatWon: The enemy ship has no one left to command it. Whatever is left of it can be looted.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterSurrender: The {0} has surrendered. The {1} remaining crew are now prisoners, and the ship is yours.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgPlayerBoarded: {0} colonists have boarded the enemy ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgBoardNeedsBand: The enemy ship must be in boarding range.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgBoardNeedsDrafted: Draft the colonists who will board. They must be aboard your ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdSendBoardersDesc: Sends the drafted colonists aboard this ship into the enemy ship. Only works in boarding range.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WeaponBand_Desc: The range band where this weapon hits best: 80% in its band, 50% one band away, 20% two bands away.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WeaponDamage_Desc: Damage of each shot and how many shots each burst has.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WeaponCooldown_Desc: Seconds between one burst and the next.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WeaponHeat_Desc: Heat each shot adds to the ship's heat.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WeaponIntercept_Desc: Chance to shoot down each missile coming at the ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_ShieldHP_Desc: Damage the shield absorbs before it falls.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_ShieldRegen_Desc: Shield points recovered per second while powered.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OrderDesc_Approach: Moves one band at a time until close to the enemy.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OrderDesc_Flee: Pulls away. In far range the ship escapes after 20 seconds if it is faster than the enemy or has its warp drive ready, and is not held by a tractor beam.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OrderDesc_Board: Moves to boarding range, where drafted colonists can storm the enemy ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OrderDesc_KeepRange: Seeks the band where the ship's weapons are strongest.
